svg.title: SQL Server to Microsoft 365 Copilot data flow
svg.desc: Rows are read from dbo.Tickets by SqlTicketsConnector, streamed over gRPC on loopback to the Microsoft Graph connector agent, ingested into Microsoft Graph as external items, indexed in the Copilot semantic index, and returned to users as grounded, security-trimmed answers in Copilot. Two optional operator-run tools, SqlGraphPush and SqlHierarchyPush, bypass the agent and write to Microsoft Graph directly.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: SQL Server to Microsoft 365 Copilot — data flow

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The connector never calls Microsoft Graph. The agent holds the tenant relationship and does all ingestion.

svg.text: Deletions: an incremental crawl sends DeletedItem for a row marked IsDeleted, within minutes. A full crawl omits it, and the agent removes what it no longer sees. Both paths end at the semantic index.
